definitions.gloss: issuance, promulgation (of an order, warning, or official directive)
definitions.explanation: The official issuing of an order, warning, regulation, or directive by an authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{避難|ひなん}{命令|めいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発令|はつれい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A volcanic eruption warning was issued.

notes:
Used for the official issuance of orders, warnings, and directives by authorities. Carries a formal, authoritative tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警報|けいほう}を{発令|はつれい}する: to issue a warning
- {命令|めいれい}を{発令|はつれい}する: to issue an order
- {避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}が{発令|はつれい}される: an evacuation advisory is issued
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}{宣言|せんげん}を{発令|はつれい}する: to declare a state of emergency

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {災害|さいがい} (natural disasters) — weather warnings, evacuation orders
- {軍事|ぐんじ} (military) — orders, mobilization
- {行政|ぎょうせい} (government) — official directives, personnel transfers

RELATED TERMS:
- {発表|はっぴょう}: announcement (more general, less authoritative)
- {公布|こうふ}: promulgation (of laws)
- {通達|つうたつ}: official notice/circular
